observations: 15N tracing supports production of labelled nitrite during aerobic ammonium oxidation.
Batch incubations show ammonium oxidation to nitrate and selective inhibition of ammonia oxidation by ATU.
AMO labelling and FISH-MAR localize ammonia-oxidizing capacity and ammonia-dependent carbon fixation to Nitrospira-containing biomass.

methodological_dimensions.analysis_pipeline: differential-coverage metagenomic binning plus physiological and single-cell assays
methodological_dimensions.experimental_unit: enrichment reactor biomass and replicated batch incubations
methodological_dimensions.replication: main conversion plots use three biological experiments; FISH/FTCP/FISH-MAR include independent and technical replication as reported

statistical_result.summary: Means/standard deviations and replicated conversion-rate measurements; no inferential test is required for the specific ammonia-to-nitrite support candidate.

study_scope.environment_or_matrix: biomass originating from a recirculating aquaculture system biofilter
study_scope.experimental_system: low-substrate hypoxic sequencing-batch enrichment plus aerobic physiological batch assays
study_scope.organism_or_community: enrichment containing two comammox Nitrospira species with anammox Brocadia and other community members
study_scope.temperature_context: enrichment reactor 23±1 C; batch assays at room temperature

observations: Near-stoichiometric ammonium oxidation to nitrate shows transient nitrite accumulation.
Growth on ammonium is tracked by qPCR targeting the single-copy amoA gene.
Metaproteomics detects expression of key ammonia- and nitrite-oxidation proteins during ammonium incubation.
The isolated non-Nitrospira betaproteobacterium shows no nitrifying activity in control experiments.

limitations.generalization_limits: moderately thermophilic enrichment and mineral-medium conditions

methodological_dimensions.analysis_pipeline: serial enrichment, metagenomic reconstruction, physiological assays, qPCR and metaproteomics
methodological_dimensions.experimental_unit: ENR4/ENR6 enrichment biomass and replicated bottle incubations
methodological_dimensions.replication: three or four biological replicates depending on condition as reported in Figure 2; paired t-test used for indicated growth comparisons

statistical_result.ancillary_statistics: paired t-tests are reported for selected qPCR growth comparisons, while chemical conversion endpoints are presented as replicated means with standard deviations
